thread:
Sam: Weekly release train check: small but real issue during the night rollout. Heads-up and short embargo.
Priya: Noticed elevated 502s on routing-tier after we enabled the new weighted-route plugin at 01:02 UTC. Error rate peaked ~01:10.
Omar: Confirmed. Looks like the plugin triggers cache invalidation and a backlog on edge proxies when many small requests hit embeddings-read. Reverting weighted-route on canary now.
Omar: Command: ``kubectl -n canary set env deployment/routing ROUTE_PLUGIN=disabled``
release-bot: [01:16 UTC] Canary env change applied. 4/4 pods ready. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1456
Priya: Post-revert 502s fell to baseline in ~4 minutes. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/routing/errors 1 watch eu and apac edges.
Helen: Because this affected user-facing errors, instituting a temporary release embargo for routing and edge config changes: 01:301:30 UTC. No routing or plugin rollouts in that window without explicit approval.
Sam: Action plan: (1) perform controlled replays with smaller fanout and warmed caches, (2) add guardrail to plugin to disable cache invalidation, (3) create canary test that simulates lots of small embeddings reads.
Omar: I'll open a follow-up issue with reproduction steps and a mitigation PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/routing-guardrails/218
Priya: Changelog notes: revert weighted-route on canary; temporary embargo for routing/edge 01:30-21:30 UTC; follow-up PR. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/release-notes/912
Sam: Thanks everyone. Keep posting updates here. If you need an exemption, ping me + include test plan. :thumbsup:
